name: One-line
mechanism: One continuous black line draws the whole figure, and flat coral, periwinkle and white patches sit behind it, deliberately knocked 2-6 px out of register.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: the one line, props, code glyphs, speed strokes, dots

palette.name: Coral
palette.role: skin patches (face, hands), stripes on tops, sun, accent patches, code dashes

palette.name: Periwinkle
palette.role: trousers, hair, screens, ground and prop patches, code dashes

palette.name: White
palette.role: tops, sleeves, shoes, cups, cloud and ground patches; mask fill

line: Ink #1d1b1a stroke 2.3, round caps and joins, one long smooth cubic path per figure; code glyphs 1.8; coral stripes 1.9; code dashes 2.3.
rules: Draw the figure as one wandering line, with an eye stroke apart.
Colour patches sit behind the line, offset 2-6 px, wobbly.
Coral, periwinkle and white only, on warm beige paper.
Stripes on tops are coral lines that stop short of the contour.
No ground plane: a squiggle or a curl under the feet.
Big joyful action poses; hands and feet as small loose loops.
